title: fix(telegram): use an HTML-escaped default message with parse_mode HTML

files.patch: @@ -131,4 +131,38 @@ func TestGetMessageDetails(t *testing.T) { require.Equal(t, "1230212", args["chat_id"]) require.Equal(t, "foo v1\\.0\\.0 is out\\! Check it out at ", args["text"]) }) + + t.Run("default message template html", func(t *testing.T) { + ctx := testctx.WrapWithCfg(t.Context(), + config.Project{ + ProjectName: "my_app&", + Announce: config.Announce{ + Telegram: config.Telegram{ + ChatID: "1230212", + ParseMode: parseModeHTML, + }, + }, + }, + testctx.WithCurrentTag("v1.0.0")) + + require.NoError(t, Pipe{}.Default(ctx)) + require.Equal(t, defaultHTMLTemplate, ctx.Config.Announce.Telegram.MessageTemplate) + args, err := getMessageDetails(ctx) + require.NoError(t, err) + require.Equal(t, "my_app<b>& v1.0.0 is out! Check it out at ", args["text"]) + }) + + t.Run("custom message template html is kept", func(t *testing.T) { + ctx := testctx.WrapWithCfg(t.Context(), + config.Project{ + Announce: config.Announce{ + Telegram: config.Telegram{ + ParseMode: parseModeHTML, + MessageTemplate: "hi", + }, + }, + }) + require.NoError(t, Pipe{}.Default(ctx)) + require.Equal(t, "hi", ctx.Config.Announce.Telegram.MessageTemplate) + }) }
